If you’ve been using Spotify for years, your music library is probably so large that manually browsing through it is a hassle. You’ve been able to pin artists, albums, and playlists to show up at the top of your library, but until recently, you’ve only been able to pin up to four items. Now, though, the streamer’s upped the pinned item limit considerably. Spotify announced on X today that users are now able to pin up to 20 items to the top of the library view. articles.title_zh: FTC 與 John Deere 的和解對維修權運動是巨大勝利
articles.summary_zh: 經過十多年的反對，農民和維修倡導者贏得了對 John Deere 長期控制的設備和服務的訪問權限。

articles.title: I Built a Self-Improving AI, and So Can You
articles.summary: Experiments in using AI to build AI show that the future doesn’t just belong to the frontier labs.
articles.title_zh: 我構建了一個自我改進的 AI，你也可以
articles.summary_zh: 使用 AI 構建 AI 的實驗表明，未來不僅屬於前沿實驗室。

articles.title: Peter Thiel’s Husband Sued a Flight Attendant Who Says He Assaulted Her on a Private Jet
articles.summary: Matthew Danzeisen’s lawyer says the case is a “shakedown about a bag” that brushed someone’s leg. Stefanie Bojar says she was injured aboard the jet—and that the lawsuit is a bullying tactic.
articles.title_zh: Peter Thiel 的丈夫起訴在私人飛機上聲稱他對其進行襲擊的空乘人員
articles.summary_zh: Matthew Danzeisen 的律師稱此案是一場關於行李箱接觸他人腿部的「勒索」，而 Stefanie Bojar 稱她在飛機上受傷，該訴訟是一種欺凌戰術。

articles.title: Dimming the Sun Would Help Lower the Risks of El Niño
articles.summary: As worries about a growing super El Niño mount, new findings suggest a radical solution to mitigating its impacts.
articles.title_zh: 暗淡太陽將有助於降低厄爾尼諾風險
articles.summary_zh: 隨著對超強厄爾尼諾的擔憂增加，新發現建議了一項激進的解決方案來緩解其影響。

articles.title: China’s Reflation Shows Signs of Peaking as Iran War Shock Fades
articles.summary: China’s reflationary momentum showed signs of stalling in June, a reminder that the outlook for domestic prices is fragile as the economy emerges from deflation after an easing of tensions over Iran led to a pullback in commodity costs.
articles.title_zh: 中國的通脹反彈隨著伊朗戰爭衝擊消退而顯示見頂跡象
articles.summary_zh: 中國的反通脹勢頭在 6 月顯示出停滯跡象，提醒人們國內物價前景脆弱，因為隨著伊朗緊張局勢緩解導致大宗商品成本下降，經濟正在擺脫通縮。

articles.title: China Chipmaker CXMT to Launch $4.3 Billion IPO Next Week
articles.summary: Memory giant CXMT Corp. will open investor subscriptions for its public offering next week, kicking off the final stage of China’s most highly anticipated listing of the year.
articles.title_zh: 中國芯片製造商 CXMT 下週啟動 43 億美元 IPO
articles.summary_zh: 存儲芯片巨頭 CXMT Corp. 將於下週開放投資者認購其公開發行，拉開中國今年最受期待的上市最後階段的序幕。

articles.title: Australia Rail Services Resuming After Telstra Outage
articles.summary: Disrupted rail services in Australia were starting to resume Thursday, after a Telstra Group Ltd. network outage knocked out mobile and data services across the country a day earlier and halted trains in some areas.
articles.title_zh: 澳洲鐵路服務在 Telstra 中斷後恢復
articles.summary_zh: 澳洲受中斷的鐵路服務在週四開始恢復，此前 Telstra Group Ltd. 網絡中斷導致全國移動和數據服務中斷，並導致某些地區列車停運。

articles.title: Recruiters Shift Focus to Specialized AI Jobs to Stay Relevant
articles.summary: Recruitment companies, facing the threat of artificial intelligence tools replacing human labor and customers embracing AI-assisted applicant screening, are adapting by honing in on niche, in-demand jobs in the AI economy.
articles.title_zh: 招聘人員轉向專業化 AI 工作以保持競爭力
articles.summary_zh: 招聘公司面臨人工智能工具取代人類勞動力的威脅，並且客戶採用 AI 輔助申請人篩選，正在通過專注於 AI 經濟中的利基高需求工作來適應。

articles.title: ADB Chief Economist on APAC Growth Outlook
articles.summary: Albert Park, Chief Economist at the Asian Development Bank, discusses the bank’s latest APAC growth outlook. The forecast sees growth staying subdued despite a modest improvement, as disruptions from the Middle East conflict continue to weigh on supply chains and production costs. He speaks with Shery Ahn on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade". (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: 亞洲開發銀行首席經濟學家談亞太增長前景
articles.summary_zh: 亞洲開發銀行首席經濟學家 Albert Park 討論該銀行最新的亞太增長前景。預測顯示增長仍然溫和，儘管有適度改善，但中東衝突造成的中斷繼續對供應鏈和生產成本造成壓力。

articles.title: Ispace CEO on Lunar Transportation Plans With SpaceX
articles.summary: Takeshi Hakamada, Founder and CEO at Ispace, discusses the company's plans to to create a lunar payload service to be launched aboard a SpaceX Starship rocket. He speaks with Shery Ahn on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: Ispace CEO 談與 SpaceX 的月球運輸計劃
articles.summary_zh: Ispace 創始人兼 CEO Takeshi Hakamada 討論該公司創建月球有效載荷服務的計劃，該服務將搭載 SpaceX Starship 火箭發射。

articles.title: Apple Supplier Luxshare Drops After $3 Billion Hong Kong Debut
articles.summary: Apple Inc. supplier Luxshare Precision Industry Co. fell in Hong Kong trading debut on Thursday after raising HK$24.3 billion ($3.1 billion) in the city’s biggest listing this year so far.
articles.title_zh: Apple 供應商立訊在香港首日交易後下跌，募資 30 億美元
articles.summary_zh: Apple Inc. 供應商立訊精密工業有限公司在香港交易首日下跌，此前該公司募集了 243 億港元（31 億美元），創下今年該市最大規模上市。

articles.title: Zhipu Surges 22% After $4 Billion Share Sale Priced at Low End
articles.summary: Shares in Chinese artificial-intelligence model maker Zhipu surged as much as 22% in Hong Kong on Thursday after the company priced a $4 billion share sale at the low end of the marketed range.
articles.title_zh: 智譜在 40 億美元股票發行按低端價格定價後飆升 22%
articles.summary_zh: 中國人工智能模型製造商智譜的股票在香港週四飆升至多 22%，此前該公司按營銷範圍低端定價 40 億美元股票發行。

articles.title: How Wayfair Has Built AI Into Its Future
articles.summary: Furniture and home goods retailer Wayfair has built a thriving e-commerce platform that's been incorporating advanced technologies throughout its 25-year history. On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, CFO Kate Gulliver tells Carol Massar how the company is now using AI to improve the customer experience and enhance internal business processes. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: Wayfair 如何將 AI 融入其未來
articles.summary_zh: 家具和家居用品零售商 Wayfair 建立了一個蓬勃發展的電子商務平台，在其 25 年歷史中一直在融入先進技術，現在正在使用 AI 改善客戶體驗。

articles.title: Wayfair's Big Bet on Bricks and Mortar
articles.summary: Wayfair is building on its success as an e-commerce furniture and home goods retailer with a move into large-format brick-and-mortar stores. On Bloomberg Chief Future Officer, CFO Kate Gulliver shows Carol Massar around Wayfair's new Atlanta store, and explains how this new initiative is helping the company create a seamless omnichannel "clicks to bricks" shopping experience. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: Wayfair 對線下實體店的重大押注
articles.summary_zh: Wayfair 正在利用其作為電子商務家具和家居用品零售商的成功，進軍大型線下實體店，通過這一新舉措幫助提升業務發展。

articles.title: Bain Capital Exits Kioxia After Chip Deal Yields Big Returns
articles.summary: Bain Capital has sold its entire stake in flash memory chipmaker Kioxia Holdings Corp., closing a chapter on a deal that’s transformed the Japanese tech and investment landscape.
articles.title_zh: 貝恩資本在芯片交易獲得豐厚回報後退出 Kioxia
articles.summary_zh: 貝恩資本已出售其在閃存芯片製造商 Kioxia Holdings Corp. 的全部股份，關閉了一筆改變日本科技和投資格局的交易。

articles.title: IMF Raises S. Korea Growth Most Among Major Economies on AI Boom
articles.summary: South Korea’s growth outlook received the biggest upgrade among the world’s 30 major economies in the International Monetary Fund’s latest projections, adding to evidence that the country’s artificial intelligence-driven semiconductor boom is overpowering the economic hit from the Middle East conflict.
articles.title_zh: IMF 因 AI 繁榮對韓國增長預測升幅在主要經濟體中最大
articles.summary_zh: 在國際貨幣基金組織最新預測中，南韓的增長前景在全球 30 個主要經濟體中升幅最大，進一步證明該國 AI 驅動的半導體繁榮正在壓倒中東衝突造成的經濟打擊。

articles.title: AI Costs Lead Westpac to Prod Staff Toward ‘Sensible’ Model Use
articles.summary: Westpac Banking Corp. is intensifying efforts to monitor artificial intelligence costs, as the Australian lender closely tracks AI tokens across the firm and routes simpler tasks to cheaper models.
articles.title_zh: AI 成本促使西太平洋銀行推動員工採用「明智」模型使用
articles.summary_zh: 西太平洋銀行正在加強努力監測人工智能成本，該澳洲貸款機構密切跟蹤整個公司的 AI tokens，並將較簡單的任務路由到成本較低的模型。

articles.title: Nvidia Rival Positron Holds Talks to Raise Funds at $5 Billion Valuation
articles.summary: AI chip startup Positron is in talks to raise about $750 million in financing during a round with two phases, part of a groundswell of companies looking to compete with Nvidia Corp.
articles.title_zh: Nvidia 競爭對手 Positron 洽談以 50 億美元估值融資
articles.summary_zh: AI 芯片初創公司 Positron 正在洽談融資約 7.5 億美元，分兩個階段進行，這是許多公司尋求與 Nvidia Corp. 競爭的熱潮的一部分。

articles.title: Nasdaq 100 Fluctuates Amid Geopolitical Tensions | The Close 7/8/2026
articles.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Nuveen Head of Fixed Income Strategy Tony Rodriguez, State Street Global Head of Gold Strategy Aakash Doshi, Coresight Research Founder & CEO Deborah Weinswig, Principal Venture Partners Founder & Managing Partner Songyee Yoon, Alphasimplex Chief Research Strategist Katy Kaminski, Principal Asset Management Chief Investment Officer & Global Head of Equities George Maris, Morgan Stanley Equity Research Managing Director Alex Straton, MNTN CEO Mark Douglas, & Former HUD Sectretary Henry Cisneros. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: Nasdaq 100 在地緣政治緊張局勢中波動 | 收盤 2026 年 7 月 8 日
articles.summary_zh: Bloomberg 電視為您帶來最新的新聞和分析，涵蓋華爾街收盤前後的最後幾分鐘和幾秒。

articles.title: SK Hynix US Offering Is More Than Seven Times Oversubscribed
articles.summary: SK Hynix Inc.’s US listing is more than seven times oversubscribed, according to people familiar with the matter, as the South Korean memory chipmaker prepares to price its offering Thursday.
articles.title_zh: SK Hynix 美國發行認購超額 7 倍以上
articles.summary_zh: 根據知情人士透露，SK Hynix Inc. 的美國上市認購超額超過 7 倍，因為這家南韓存儲芯片製造商準備在週四定價其發行。

articles.title: Early-Stage VC Founder: AI Race Is Now About Efficiency
articles.summary: In this segment, Songyee Yoon, Director on HP's Board and Founder of Principal Venture Partners, discusses the emerging divergence between the chip cycle and the hyperscaler cycle amid the AI build-out. She highlights the critical issue of whether hyperscalers will reduce their spending as the costs of AI infrastructure escalate, a factor that could significantly impact the broader AI investment landscape and equity market performance. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Katie Greifeld on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: 早期風投創始人：AI 競賽現在關於效率
articles.summary_zh: Principal Venture Partners 創始人、惠普董事會成員 Songyee Yoon 討論了 AI 構建過程中芯片週期和超大規模計算者週期之間的新興分歧，強調了超大規模計算者是否會因成本而減少支出的關鍵問題。

articles.title: Meta to Build First Data Center in Canada, Expanding Global Fleet
articles.summary: Meta Platforms Inc. will invest around $10 billion to build its first data center in Canada as the company expands its infrastructure to support its artificial intelligence ambitions.
articles.title_zh: Meta 將在加拿大建設首個數據中心，擴展全球基礎設施
articles.summary_zh: Meta Platforms Inc. 將投資約 100 億美元在加拿大建設其首個數據中心，以擴展其基礎設施以支持其人工智能雄心。

articles.title: MNTN CEO: We’re Over-Building Data Centers in the US
articles.summary: Mark Douglas, CEO of the ad tech company MNTN, discussed Meta's reported ambitions to expand beyond advertising into cloud infrastructure. Douglas expressed skepticism about Meta's ability to compete with established cloud providers like AWS and Google Cloud, citing high switching costs for customers and Meta's lack of excess AI infrastructure capacity to monetize. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Katie Greifeld on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: MNTN CEO：我們在美國過度建設數據中心
articles.summary_zh: 廣告科技公司 MNTN 的 CEO Mark Douglas 討論了 Meta 報導的超越廣告進入雲基礎設施的雄心，他對 Meta 與 AWS 和 Google Cloud 等老牌雲供應商競爭的能力表示懷疑，理由是客戶轉換成本高昂。

articles.title: Bloomberg Deals 7/8/2026
articles.summary: A weekly, midday program that delivers high-impact, editorially driven coverage of the most important corporate transactions shaping the global market. Today's guests: Paul Weiss Global Co-head of M&A Krish Veeraraghavan and Alix Partners Partner & Managing Director Grace Lee. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: Bloomberg Deals 2026 年 7 月 8 日
articles.summary_zh: 一個每週中午播出的節目，提供對塑造全球市場的最重要企業交易的高影響力、編輯驅動的報導。

articles.title: US Judge Allows SEC-Musk Deal Despite ‘Significant Misgivings’
articles.summary: A US judge signed off on Elon Musk paying $1.5 million to end a Securities and Exchange Commission lawsuit that accused him of cheating Twitter Inc. investors when he missed a deadline in 2022 to disclose his growing stake in the company.
articles.title_zh: 美國法官儘管有「重大疑慮」仍允許 SEC-Musk 交易
articles.summary_zh: 美國法官批准了埃隆·馬斯克支付 150 萬美元來終止 SEC 訴訟的協議，該訴訟指控他在 2022 年未能及時披露對 Twitter Inc. 日益增長的股份時欺騙投資者。

articles.title: India’s JioStar Taps AI for Shopping, TV Movie Night Ideas
articles.summary: JioStar is betting that conversations with viewers powered by generative AI will become a powerful tool for the streaming TV company.
articles.title_zh: 印度 JioStar 利用 AI 提供購物、電視電影之夜創意
articles.summary_zh: JioStar 押注由生成式 AI 驅動的與觀眾的對話將成為這家流媒體電視公司的強大工具。

articles.title: BofA Bankers U-Turn on OpenAI
articles.summary:
Bloomberg's Liana Baker joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Bank of America handed a $520 million credit line to OpenAI in recent weeks after previously spurning the artificial intelligence giant’s request, according to people with knowledge of the matter.
. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: 美國銀行家對 OpenAI 的態度出現逆轉
articles.summary_zh: 據知情人士透露，美國銀行在最近幾週向 OpenAI 提供了 5.2 億美元的信用額度，此前該銀行曾拒絕了這家人工智能巨頭的請求。

articles.title: Sonos Cuts Top Design and Product Executives as Part of Layoffs
articles.summary: Sonos Inc. has pushed out some of its top design and product management executives as part of job cuts in recent weeks, raising questions about the company’s ability to develop breakthrough products beyond its short-term hardware road map of safe bets.
articles.title_zh: Sonos 裁減頂級設計和產品執行官，進行裁員
articles.summary_zh: Sonos Inc. 已在最近幾週的裁員中解雇了一些頂級設計和產品管理執行官，引發了人們對該公司開發突破性產品（超越其短期硬件路線圖的保守選擇）能力的質疑。

articles.title: AI Chip Startup Raises Funds at $11B Valuation
articles.summary: Bloomberg's Ryan Gould joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Chip startup SambaNova has raised $1 billion at an $11 billion valuation, underscoring investors’ conviction in rising demand for infrastructure tied to artificial intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: AI 晶片新創公司以 110 億美元估值融資
articles.summary_zh: 晶片新創公司 SambaNova 以 110 億美元估值融資 10 億美元，凸顯投資者對人工智慧基礎設施需求持續增長的信心。

articles.title: BofA Makes U-Turn on OpenAI, Provides $520M Credit Line
articles.summary: Bank of America is changing its tune on OpenAI: after initially passing on lending to the AI company, it is now extending a $520 million credit line, according to sources. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: 美銀對 OpenAI 態度大轉變，提供 5.2 億美元信用額度
articles.summary_zh: 美國銀行改變態度，在最初拒絕向 OpenAI 提供貸款後，現已提供 5.2 億美元信用額度。

articles.title: Incredible Demand for Inferencing at High Speeds: SambaNova CEO
articles.summary: Chip startup SambaNova raised $1 billion at an $11 billion valuation, underscoring investors’ conviction in rising demand for infrastructure tied to AI. SambaNova CEO Rodrigo Liang joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
articles.title_zh: 高速推理需求驚人：SambaNova 執行長談前景
articles.summary_zh: 晶片新創公司 SambaNova 以 110 億美元估值融資 10 億美元，反映投資者對 AI 基礎設施需求不斷上升的信心。

articles.title: Suspecting AI cheating, Ivy League prof ordered an in-person final; scores fell 50%
articles.summary: Ivy League college students are, by definition, intelligent. They don't need to use generative AI to cheat on exams; they could just learn the material. But they also tend to be competitive, ambitious, and overscheduled, so AI can look like an easy shortcut that makes more time in their lives for things that can't be done by a chatbot. When the pressure is on, which approach do they choose? A new scandal at Brown University reveals that huge numbers of these students are likely to cheat. Record scores A recent survey of Princeton students found that 29.9 percent admitted to cheating with AI on at least one exam or assignment. But the recent situation at Brown gives us a better sense of what this kind of cheating looks like in one particular class—and just how much it may be substituting fo
articles.title_zh: 懷疑 AI 作弊，常春藤盟校教授要求面對面期末考；成績下降 50%
articles.summary_zh: 常春藤盟校教授因懷疑學生使用生成式 AI 作弊，改為採用面對面期末考，結果學生成績平均下跌 50%。

articles.title: Lawsuit: Man used Grok to make 7K sex images of stepdaughter, then shot himself
articles.summary: One of the most horrific cases of allegedly Grok-generated child sex images was shared in a proposed class action lawsuit that was expanded Tuesday. Now, young girls not only accuse X and xAI of building toxic AI "nudify" tools but also of shielding child predators by obstructing police investigations into Grok-generated child sex abuse materials (CSAM). In March, a girl’s stepfather took his own life after cops discovered that he had used Grok to create 7,000 sexually explicit images using one photo taken when his stepdaughter was 11 years old, the amended complaint alleged. Grok allowed the man to generate extreme images depicting incest and rape without flagging any harmful behavior, the complaint said. Seemingly, xAI’s child safety system only intervened after the man input a prompt fo
articles.title_zh: 訴訟：男子用 Grok 製作 7000 張繼女色情影像，隨後自殺
articles.summary_zh: 一起涉及 Grok 生成兒童色情影像的駭人案件在擴大的集體訴訟中披露，控告 X 和 xAI 建立有害的 AI「去馬賽克」工具並庇護兒童掠奪者。

articles.title: Judge rejects Kalshi attempt to override New York state gambling laws
articles.summary: Kalshi lost an attempt to override New York's state gambling laws yesterday, with a federal judge rejecting the prediction market operator's request to prevent enforcement of the rules. Kalshi is appealing the decision to a higher court. This is one of numerous cases in which judges must decide whether state laws are preempted by federal regulation of prediction markets. New York Governor Kathy Hochul and Attorney General Letitia James issued a joint statement on the ruling today. “New York’s gambling laws are designed to protect consumers," they said. "Kalshi tried to ignore them. Yesterday, they lost in court. We will continue to hold all gambling platforms accountable to the law—and that includes prediction markets.” Read full article Comments
articles.title_zh: 法官駁回 Kalshi 推翻紐約州博彩法律的嘗試
articles.summary_zh: 聯邦法官駁回預測市場運營商 Kalshi 推翻紐約州博彩法律的請求，Kalshi 已決定上訴。

articles.title: Google pays $250K for Linux vulnerability allowing guest VM escapes
articles.summary: A Linux vulnerability that allows untrusted virtual machines to gain root access to host machines is one of two high-severity flaws to surface this week in the open source operating system. The vulnerability resides in KVM, which is, in essence, a virtual machine app included in the kernel of many Linux distributions. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-53359, allows guest virtual machines—such as those used in cloud platforms to isolate one user’s instance from the host OS and other user instances—to break out of that container. Januscape: A threat to cloud platforms The vulnerability affects KVM running on both AMD and Intel processors. It exploits bugs residing in the KVM guest-side , the portion of the VM that consists of only resources like the OS or drivers present in the guest VM
articles.title_zh: Google 為允許虛擬機逃逸的 Linux 漏洞支付 25 萬美元
articles.summary_zh: 一個允許不可信虛擬機獲得主機根存取權限的 Linux 漏洞是本週開源作業系統浮現的兩個高危漏洞之一，存在於 KVM 中。

articles.title: Aussie gov't tells volunteers to throw out thousands of functioning test routers
articles.summary: Last week, thousands of SamKnows routers were bricked after a government program ran its course. In 2020, as part of a program conducted by the Australian Competition & Consumer Commission (ACCC), the Australian government's chief competition regulator, thousands of volunteers received routers to help test and report on the typical speed and performance of broadband plans in Australia. (More specifically, the Measuring Broadband Australia (MBA) program targeted fixed-line broadband services provided over the NBN, Australia's government-owned wholesale open-access broadband network, as well as services delivered over other access networks.)
